name: Nuvio Enhanced (Unofficial)
subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.
description:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

Unsigned sideload IPA 0.6.2.1 (196), cleanup/196 9bc9da2e. Sign with SideStore, AltStore, or TrollStore. No Apple certificate is embedded.

Improved:
- Behind-the-scenes cleanup: downloads, player launches, network and settings code now share one path each, so they behave the same everywhere.
- Faster test builds.

Fixed:
- A skip mark you imported from your own TheIntroDB submission is now labelled "TheIntroDB (yours)" everywhere, the same as in the player.

Unsigned sideload IPA 0.6.1.1 (175), sync/upstream-0.6.1 f9a2da5f. Sign with SideStore, AltStore, or TrollStore. No Apple certificate is embedded.

New:
- Watch Party from the latest upstream Nuvio (0.6.1): watch in sync with friends, share invites as nuvio.tv links, see the party before you join (experimental).
- MDBList dynamic and liked lists in the library.
- Download from the hold menu on Continue Watching and Next Up cards: it downloads that exact episode or movie with auto-pick and Change source. If it's already downloaded or downloading, the item opens Downloads instead.
- What's new now loads the latest release notes from GitHub Releases, so notes fixed after a build still show up. It's cached for offline use, falls back to the notes built into the app, and never delays launch.

Improved:
- Updated to the latest upstream Nuvio (0.6.1-beta), with the updated p2p streaming engine (0.1.5), better picture-in-picture on iOS and new translations.
- Skip buttons, auto-skip and seeking follow the Watch Party's control rules, and a skip is shared with the party.
- In a Watch Party, an episode that isn't fully analysed is analysed in the background without asking, so you never pause and drop out of sync. Auto-play next episode waits for the party.
- Smart Downloads start the next episode while you watch, not after: about 3 minutes before the credits (your own mark, then TheIntroDB, then on-device), or 8 minutes before the end / at 85 % without credit times, and at half-way for large episodes. Once per episode, throttled while you watch, never unaired or already downloaded episodes.
- Downloaded episodes show where their skip times come from, for each of intro, recap and credits: You, TheIntroDB (yours), TheIntroDB, On-device, and so on. Online sources show up after the episode has been played once.
- Downloading a single episode or movie picks its source automatically when auto-pick is on, the same way Download Season does (including TorBox cached torrents). Tap Change source to choose from the list.
- The Good / Wrong prompt after Skip now shows about 4 seconds after the skip lands, so you can see where it landed. It stays for 8 seconds, can be closed, and Wrong has a Rewind 5s button to check again.

Fixed:
- Holding for 2x speed while playback switched to the downloaded file no longer leaves it stuck at 2x. Letting go, a cancelled hold, or the player switching or reloading always goes back to your normal speed.
- Download Season with auto-pick on now picks a source the same way auto-play does, including TorBox cached torrents, instead of opening the full source list. It waits for the sources and the TorBox cache check, and shows the list only if nothing matches.
- Download Season no longer selects or queues episodes that haven't aired yet. They're shown greyed out with their air date.
- The Skip Intro button no longer appears 10 seconds before the intro. It shows exactly when the segment starts, with its start and end times (for example Skip Intro 1:12–2:41).
- Tapping Good or Wrong after a skip no longer brings up the "isn't fully analysed yet" prompt. That prompt only shows when an episode starts.

Unsigned sideload IPA 0.5.10.3 (168), enhanced 7e3c0e04. Sign with SideStore, AltStore, or TrollStore. No Apple certificate is embedded.

New:
- After you tap Skip, a small Good / Wrong prompt shows for a few seconds. Good saves it, Wrong lets you nudge the start and end. Both are sent to TheIntroDB when submitting is on. Turn it off in Settings > Playback > Ask after Skip.
- Your marks teach the on-device detector: an intro or credits you mark or confirm on a downloaded episode is matched against the rest of the season, also episodes where nothing was found before.

Improved:
- Your own marks always win over online and on-device times for that episode, streamed or downloaded.
- Times you send with Submit Timestamps are kept on the phone too.
- Skip settings show how the TheIntroDB import went: how many of your submissions came in and when, or why the key was refused.
- The Skip button shows where its times came from: You, TheIntroDB (yours), TheIntroDB, or On-device.
- Re-analyze one episode, a season or a whole show: long-press a downloaded episode or show, or use the refresh button on a season or in Storage. Your own skip marks are kept.
- Playback comes first: while you watch, one download runs at a time and on-device analysis runs slowly in the background. If the player buffers, both wait until playback is smooth again. Full speed returns when the player closes or after 2 minutes paused.
- Playing a downloaded episode that isn't fully analysed asks (without stopping playback): Play now, Finish first (with a progress bar, then plays), or Finish in background. Skip times found while you watch are used straight away. Pick a default with Don't ask again, or in Playback settings.
- Downloads shows speed and time left for each running episode, and for the whole season on its group row, using the same estimate as the Live Activity.
- Downloads shows what you have watched: a check on watched episodes and movies, a progress bar on ones you are part-way through, and an Unwatched only filter inside a show.
- Download Season with auto-pick on: the source list stays folded while it picks; each episode shows the source it will use, with Change source for alternatives. Choose myself opens the full list, and it opens by itself if auto-pick finds nothing.
- Download Season: pick the episodes first (or the whole season), then sources are searched only for those. Downloaded and watched episodes start unticked.
- The download Live Activity has its own StandBy layout: dark, large title, thick bar and time left, readable under the red night tint.
- Your earlier TheIntroDB submissions are brought onto the phone when you play that show, and teach the detector too.

Fixed:
- Skip Recap shows while you are inside a recap, even when the intro's early Skip button would overlap it.
- Submit Timestamps: each segment type fills in its own known times (or stays empty), and what you type for one type is kept when you switch to another.
- Tapping the download Live Activity no longer stacks another Downloads screen each time; it goes back to the one already open.
- On-device analysis picks up again by itself after playback, after the background task, when the charger goes in, and retries a failed file a little later. Episodes no longer sit at "partly analysed, queued" until Analyse now is tapped.
- A downloaded file that got stuck buffering (for example right after jumping to the resume point) is seeked again after 5 seconds and reopened if it is still stuck.
- Episode cards: the watched check and the download badge no longer overlap at the top right.
- Morphed tab bar: after it expands from the small Home button, tapping Search, Library or Profile works again instead of doing nothing until it collapses.
- A tab tapped while the app is still getting ready now opens as soon as it can instead of being ignored.

Unsigned sideload IPA 0.5.9.1 (159), enhanced c7d418f5. Sign with SideStore, AltStore, or TrollStore. No Apple certificate is embedded.

New since 0.5.9 (152):
- Fixed the HTTP 400 error when starting some downloads.
- No stale Live Activity left behind after downloads finish or are cancelled.
- Delete after watching: more reliable removal once an episode or movie is watched.
- Home hero carousel fix.
- Player: download button to save what you are watching.
- Switch to downloaded file while watching (Settings → Downloads, on by default): when the download finishes, playback moves to the local file at the same position without a visible jump. It can also switch to a partly downloaded file once enough is on disk, with a watchdog that switches back to the stream if the download falls behind.

Unsigned sideload IPA 0.5.9 (152), enhanced 281c8f4f. Sign with SideStore, AltStore, or TrollStore. No Apple certificate is embedded.

New since 0.5.8 (144):
- Season download sheet: sources show up as they answer, one scrollable list, auto-picked by your auto-play settings with Change, a per-episode source pick, watched episodes marked, and episodes already in Downloads skipped.
- Early play: an in-progress download keeps playing after a seek instead of jumping to the end, and the player's buffer bar shows how far the download reaches.
- iOS background downloads: keep running while locked or in the background, retry dropped connections and timeouts from the bytes on disk, and a file finished during a background relaunch is kept and marked done.
- Season queue: episodes start lowest first, two at a time. Resume season restarts partly downloaded episodes first, and pause season no longer cascades.
- Downloads screen: active season card with Pause, Resume and Cancel season (also from Shows, a show's seasons, and long-press). Waiting, paused (tap to resume) and failed (tap to retry) states also show on episode cards, details buttons and the episode sheet.
- Storage: a card with how much Nuvio, other apps and free space use, sizes per title and season with delete, leftover file cleanup, a low-space warning in the season sheet, and downloads stop with "Not enough space" instead of filling the disk.
- Delete after watching: works with Trakt/MDBList history and after early play.
- Live Activity: one per season with combined progress, updates about once a second, an estimated bar and countdown that keep moving while the app is suspended, a native-style Dynamic Island layout with a plain blue arrow icon, and no stuck activity after a cancel.

Unsigned sideload IPA 0.5.8 (144), enhanced 234b57b1. Sign with SideStore, AltStore, or TrollStore. No Apple certificate is embedded.

New since 0.5.6 (140):
- Downloads: play an in-progress download from the partial file (iOS), resume an iOS download after the phone locks, at most two active downloads, season download sheet with episode sizes, download percent on movie and episode rows, delete a finished download after in-app playback, 416 for bytes not on disk yet.
- Chromecast support from upstream, with the intro flag kept.
- Player: seek-bar buffer end fix on iOS, stall cause details, chapters panel position fix, player chrome sizing and safe-area fixes, developer overlay restored.
- Running commit shown in Settings and the player.
- Upstream Nuvio and Nuvio Enhanced merges.
